auth.F: Default Clerk session JWT (getToken()), verified purchaser; no org/tenant prerequisite. Native ClerkUserGuard; do not substitute template capiro or TenantGuard.
auth.S-read: Default Clerk session JWT (getToken()), native TenantGuard resolves current canonical tenant and active membership; any member read.
auth.S-write: S-read plus exact native Clerk org-admin role and onboardingFlowVersion===1 checked server-side.
auth.IT: Native capability-only endpoint, no Clerk requirement; gateway should omit Authorization/cookies. Emailed 64-lowercase-hex token is credential. Fixed narrow public path.
auth.C-member: Clerk getToken({template:'capiro'}); Core canonical tenant/user middleware + role minimum standard_user where declared.
auth.C-admin: C-member plus native Core minimum user_admin (higher capiro_admin allowed by canonical rank).
auth.P: Public, unauthenticated; credentials omitted. No arbitrary URL or service selection.
auth.C-session: Clerk getToken({template:'capiro'}); Core canonical authenticated tenant/user context. GET /api/me has no additional route role annotation.

rows.input: firstName,lastName strings 1–100; orgName 2–200; exact DTO only
rows.effectsAndBinding: Purchaser upsert + session admission; existing provisioned session reused. No client idempotency key or complete concurrent-registration guarantee. Receipt sessionId/current actor binds subsequent flow; not new-tenant success.

rows.response: Same native FunnelSession, including nullable names, non-null itAdminEmails and sessionId; 404 means no purchaser/session
rows.effectsAndBinding: Read can perform best-effort Stripe status reads; missing stripe properties mean unavailable, not failure/paid. Only this 404 maps to normal unregistered state; never treat 401/403 that way.
Fetches Clerk email; can advance to verified. No receipt actor/session echo; correlate current attempt then refetch session.
Requires verified, rejects switching after payment committed (409). Ack does not echo chosen plan/version; refetch current session; do not assume generic safe POST replay.

rows.response: Array of {docType,version,html,pdfS3Key?}; active tos and sa for current plan
rows.effectsAndBinding: Requires plan_selected; immutable display/acceptance must bind received versions and current plan. Optional pdfS3Key is storage identity, not a public URL; bounded inert HTML rendering needed.

Records signed legal consent and can email copies; exact versions validated server-side. Ack is not proof email delivered, does not echo consent id/hash. Lost response must retain uncertainty; read session/signed PDF, not blind reaccept. Native deduplicates recorded session/doc/version on read-before-insert; this is not a browser idempotency key or a new signature replacement receipt.

rows.response: application/pdf attachment bytes; fixed name Capiro-Terms-of-Service-signed.pdf or Capiro-Subscription-Agreement-signed.pdf; 404 no signed consent
rows.effectsAndBinding: Regenerates signed PDF for current purchaser session. Native controller has no explicit byte cap/hash response. Gateway must bound bytes, validate PDF content type, sanitize/replace filename, no-store and discard stale-scope results.

TRIAL only; creates Stripe SetupIntent and updates latest intent id; each call can create another, no public idempotency input. Nullable secret means no usable Elements intent. Keep actual confirmed intent and method bound; do not automatically replay.

rows.input: method card|ach|wire; billingContact? email; setupIntentId? string 1–128
rows.effectsAndBinding: TRIAL only. Actual client-confirmed intent checked against purchaser; card requires succeeded; ACH permits processing/requires_action. Wire stores billing contact, not settled payment. Bind returned method and current session; no invented charge/settlement receipt.

rows.input: profiles coerced integer 1–100000; method card|ach|wire; billingContact? email
rows.effectsAndBinding: PAID only; effective quantity >= canonical MIN_CLIENT_SLOTS. Existing live subscription reused; incomplete may be canceled/replaced; fresh creation lacks public idempotency key. Receipt does not echo quantity/method/purchaser; no automatic retry or success claim from clientSecret alone.

Despite name, this POST can advance funnel. Wire advanced means invoice issued, not paid; ACH processing may advance; card requires active. Poll sequentially for current subscription attempt; receipt omits subscription id.

Requires payment_on_file; invite mode must include a super admin. Stores designation, not invitation delivery. Old UI supplies email/role only; do not require optional names or array in gateway if absent natively.
Requires roles_designated; managed path can notify Capiro staff. Ack lacks echoed mode; read session, preserve uncertainty if response lost.

Requires import_pref. Omit empty optional strings; no browser tenantId. Stores profile/contact, not tenant creation. Ack has no input/version echo; reread current session. Native merge preserves omitted optional fields and adds rather than replaces IT contacts; no clear/remove contract is provided.

CAS org_setup→provisioning; duplicate observes provisioning/provisioned. Creates tenant/org, may send invites/email. Failure 502 can follow durable partial effects; failed state requires owner intervention/reset, not a new registration/retry loop. Only provisioned with valid tenant/slug means complete.
Read recovery path for provisioning, no sessionId in this projection; bind to current purchaser/session lifetime rather than assert unsupported echo.

Reads allowed to any active member. Task read status includes skipped; legacy tenant returns complete=true and must show switch notice. No tenant UUID in response; current authenticated org request owns scope; never compare guessed authority.

rows.input: task it_email|import|firm_ai|invites; {from,to} each none|waiting|verifying|done; invites→done rejected
rows.effectsAndBinding: CAS compares exact from; 409 requires current-state reconciliation, not automatic retry with refreshed from. skipped is READ-only here. Validate task equals requested and status equals to, then refetch state.

rows.response: Array of IT invite metadata, not {ok:true} and never raw capability token
rows.effectsAndBinding: Creates random 7-day capability + email effect, may set task waiting. Bind returned normalized email/current scope, no delivery guarantee. Lost receipt can follow invite+send; do not replay automatically.
Rotates capability token/expiry and sends mail; rejects already granted. Repetition can invalidate previous link. Refetch metadata; no receipt invitationId echo and no delivery guarantee.

Requires it_email done/skipped and import done; firm_ai optional. Marks invites done and stamps trial clock once; complete does not prove all invites delivered. Receipt should be current scope, complete=true, refreshed authoritative tasks.
Capability read, no Clerk. 404 unknown/revoked; 403 malformed/expired. Providers false disable action. Never log/persist capability in analytics; avoid arbitrary token lengths/path interpolation.

Generates signed 30-minute OAuth state, not connection success. Exact provider HTTPS origin/path required; validate nested redirect_uri against fixed configured native callback origin/path; never synthesize state or proxy callback as a new operation.
Google-only deferred state; live capability retained. Already granted/verified is no-op; acknowledgement does not mean connected. Refetch same capability view; signed-out access intentional.

rows.response: Native full me object; Onboard needs top-level billingAdmin:boolean
rows.effectsAndBinding: Actual response also has user.id/clerkUserId and tenant.id/role. Use existing canonical identity owner; billingAdmin alone is UI capability, not authority. 401/403 invalidates protected scope.
Read only; search may be global data under authenticated caller. Bound q and response count/size; failure does not mean zero results.
Tenant-current read; null is unselected, not failed. Preserve omitted/error distinction.
Changes firm anchor. Validate returned id equals submitted id, invalidate candidates. No CAS version or idempotency key; late current-scope response must not overwrite newer selection.
Bind candidates to current registrant before import; no anchor returns nulls+empty, failure must not masquerade as empty.

rows.input: Onboard subset {name:string1–200,website?:URL with protocol optional,description?:string}; do not expand operation to all native DTO fields
rows.response: Full client object (at least id,name,tenantId); frontend formerly picked id/name
rows.effectsAndBinding: Controller class minimum standard_user, not user_admin; keep backend roles authoritative. Creates client plus detached enrichment; no idempotency key. Unknown result cannot be safely repeated; preserve draft/current-read recovery without claiming enrichment done.

rows.input: {ldaClientIds:integer[] length1–100}; old wrapper chunks larger selections
rows.effectsAndBinding: Each id must belong to current firm's registrant; duplicates skipped using per-id transaction/lock. 402 before batch at cap, per-row skips midbatch. Validate returned ids subset of submitted ids and created==items.length, disjoint outcomes; preserve prior chunks if later failure; no all-or-nothing claim.
Public HTTP catalog includes all scopes; Onboard uses only firm-soul,firm-compass,playbook. Do not import private catalog implementation or allow arbitrary dynamic memory types.

rows.input: type restricted to firm-soul|firm-compass|playbook; fixed slug firm
rows.effectsAndBinding: Nonexistent known file returns skeleton; not 404. pendingReview is separate from active body. Validate requested type/firm slug/clientId=null; don't invent revision/CAS or treat pending contents as active.

rows.response: {status:'pending_review',candidateId:string,activeItemUnchanged:true} for FIRM; {ok:true,updatedAt} applies USER scope only
rows.effectsAndBinding: Old Onboard return type is stale. Creates pending reviewed proposal, no immediate active save, no revision/CAS. Keep draft/candidate receipt, show submitted-for-review; no auto task-complete based on old ok assumption.

rows.input: {email,role:user_admin|standard_user,firstName?:1–100,lastName?:1–100}; omit native redirectUrl from port operation
rows.effectsAndBinding: Revokes matching pending invite then creates Clerk invitation. Bind normalized returned email/role to intended request; ack != accepted/member or delivered mail. Unknown reply may have sent/revoked; no automatic replay.

Boot read must work signed out. Public-only values; funnelEnabled and nullable provider keys are availability, not authorization. Never let response apiBaseUrl choose gateway upstream, and restrict internal/external navigation to approved destinations.
